data: For fiscal 2023, the year ended January 29, 2023, NVIDIA reported revenue of $26,974 million (about $27.0 billion) and net income of $4,368 million, or $1.74 per diluted share, according to its Form 10-K. Revenue was essentially flat compared with fiscal 2022's $26,914 million, rising only $60 million, or about 0.2%. Net income fell roughly 55% from $9,752 million in fiscal 2022. Two items drove much of that drop: a $1,353 million acquisition termination cost and gross profit that declined to $15,356 million from $17,475 million as cost of revenue climbed.
